coverImageAlt: Four translucent drafting layers align on cyan pegs above blank paper, marked by one orange spacer.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Several transparent drafting layers hovering in precise registration above one blank foundation sheet, expressing a product requirements template that separates concerns while preserving traceability and alignment.
Scene/backdrop: Deep slate tabletop with a warm-paper base plane and generous empty space, free of tools, labels, and screens.
Subject: One dominant vertical stack of four broad translucent acetate sheets, each carrying only abstract cutout geometry rather than marks; cyan registration pegs align the layers and a small orange spacer distinguishes one decision layer.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; frosted acetate, vellum, machined pegs, paper fibers, and subtle physical shadows.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; elevated oblique view with the separated layers forming a clear stepped silhouette; crop-safe focal subject; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; soft cyan transmitted light through the layers with one sparing orange spacer.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: translucent frosted acetate, thick vellum, matte metal pegs, deckled base paper.
Constraints: original image; coherent PRD-template family yet unmistakably distinct from a framed layout; one dominant layered-registration metaphor; all surfaces blank and unmarked; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: software layer panels, annotated technical drawings, readable diagrams, overlapping clutter, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull back so every layer and peg is inside the inner 84% with a clear border; remove the full orange sheet and use orange only on one small spacer; replace all node-link, interface-like, or symbol-like cutouts with a few large nonrepresentational architectural apertures that cannot read as diagrams, writing, or product UI.
